config.dependencies: own page code+exact fields and frozen shared model only; no original activations or other pages
config.known_fields: exact sign/exponent and low b mantissa bits; high bits masked internally before every prediction
config.normalizers: TRAIN per-layer mean/std accumulated float64, +1e-6; centers TRAIN per-channel median exponent rounded down
config.objective: BCE in bits over omitted mantissa bitplanes; surrogate, not joint exact syndrome/escape packet rate. DEV actual bytes select recipe.
config.position_features: actual frozen split-half RoPE inverse frequency per K coordinate; V neutral sine/cosine (0,1); zero per-page bytes

bf16_probe.scope: BF16 allocation and matmul functionality, not proof of native hardware execution or SDPA support

model_identity.placement: Explicit single device; no device_map, automatic offload, or remote code

metadata.scope: Functional learned bit predictor; all encoder/decoder/normalizer/center/state bytes charged. Same recorded backend contract only; no cross-device portable replay or GPU syndrome throughput claim.

training.channel_sampling_rule: independent seeded per-layer channel permutations; full cycles without replacement; wrap reorders next cycle to avoid within-minibatch duplicates; legacy channel RNG draws consumed so source/window/residue addresses match random

coverage_summary.interpretation: Optimizer exposure only. Initial TRAIN priors and source normalizers use all selected TRAIN captures; shared parameters may generalize to channels absent from optimizer minibatches.

training.diagnostic_contract: Read-only observer at explicit updates; no DEV gradients, early stopping, checkpoint selection or optimizer mutation. Diagnostic metrics/full coverage are external to deployment state.
training.sampling: round-robin layers; identical seeded capture/window/channel/residue schedule across modes

geometry.source: Actual returned cache tensor dimensions, not hidden_size/query_heads

producer_audit.on_tile_stage: attention_forward_post_hook; before decoder layer resumes and root model returns
producer_audit.replay_device: original producer device; actual loaded Qwen3 apply_rotary_pos_emb
producer_audit.rope_position_rule: contiguous absolute positions starting at zero
producer_audit.scope: Read-only inside-forward hooks; only fixed selected tile intersections exported. Hidden and projection tensors are temporary diagnostics, not free reconstruction state. Model retains full raw cache. No speed, capacity, compressed attention or serving result is implied.

prefill.scope: Instrumented forward includes actual producer hooks, diagnostic CPU copies and selected-device code emission when supplied. CPU syndrome/position packets are constructed afterward. Full raw KV remains resident.
